name: PrepAI
notes: The `heart` is the brand mark — a heart shape representing wellness and health intelligence. The `bars` (two vertical rectangles on the left) suggest health monitoring/metrics. The `pulse` is an ECG-style zigzag line running through the heart, evoking vital signs and real-time health tracking. Animations should read as 'monitor → analyze → empower' — the heart is the container, the pulse is the data, and the bars are the quantified insight.
